name: BMW Personal Pilot / ADAS

about: BMW commercialized Level 3 in limited contexts but 2026 reporting indicates they are also stepping back from L3 on cost and demand grounds, favoring Level 2 systems.

metrics: Personal Pilot L3 reportedly discontinued after 7-Series facelift in 2026

sources.title: Following Mercedes, BMW also abandons Level 3 automated driving
